request.deadline: 12-month program; Month 4 Phase 3 release gate stated
deliverables: Phase 2 identification of integration, product, and ecosystem-support gaps
Phase 3 deployment of incentives and capital after Operating Group affirmation of the release plan
Quarterly financial and ecosystem impact reporting
Independent audit or assurance funding allocation
Return-to-treasury triggers for unused, unearned, unreleased, or excess funds
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with Intersect managing withdrawn funds directly; AlphaGrowth executes under Operating Group oversight.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund AlphaGrowth's Cardano PRIME, a 12-month community-overseen program for DeFi protocol readiness, incentives, and durable liquidity growth across Cardano markets.

claims.claim: PRIME requests ₳120,000,000 and is conditional on an applicable Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a having enough remaining capacity at enactment.
The program is intended to improve DeFi protocol readiness, activate incentives responsibly, and grow durable liquidity across Cardano markets over 12 months.
As of June 2026, Cardano DeFi has approximately $90M in TVL and $45M in stablecoin supply.

The proposal says Cardano's infrastructure additions, including USDCx, LayerZero, Pyth, and Dune, have not yet converted into enough durable DeFi liquidity, application depth, LP participation, or institutional awareness.
AlphaGrowth will produce analyses, recommendations, and disbursement memos, while the Operating Group reviews and may veto or condition material actions.
Intersect will manage withdrawn funds in a separate auditable account and AlphaGrowth will not unilaterally hold or control program funds.
The proposal includes a dedicated ₳2,000,000 allocation for independent audit or assurance.
The performance fee is tied to verified qualifying TVL growth, excluding ADA price effects and non-PRIME-attributable TVL under the attribution methodology.
AlphaGrowth has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the prior 24 months.
Intersect will use the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework, with a GitHub repository and two audit reports referenced for the budget management contracts.

summary: The document describes a ₳120,000,000, 12-month DeFi liquidity and incentives program executed by AlphaGrowth, overseen by an Operating Group, and custody-managed by Intersect with milestone gates, reporting, audit allocation, and return-to-treasury triggers.
